obfuscation_indicators: new risks emerge from time to time
risk_summary: The excerpt contains substantial quantitative disclosure on revenue, segment performance, margins, geographic exposure, facilities, and capacity, but is embedded in extensive safe-h harbor and promotional language. Risk tone is mixed: fiscal-year sales declined 6.6%, particularly in CTG and CEC, while gross profit and selected segment margins improved through mix and execution. The complex, highly detailed segment descriptions and broad forward-looking disclaimers reduce clarity around specific future downside exposures.
